{{Quote|You sing a song of a legend. I'm just a soldier, Gobi.|Cham Syndulla|<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla">''[[The Clone Wars: The Ballad of Cham Syndulla]]''</ref>}}
'''Cham Syndulla''' was a revolutionary [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] who formed and led the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Before the war, Syndulla, a member of his planet's nobility, opposed both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and Ryloth's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], believing Taa to be uncaring of the fate of the Twi'lek people. After the Clone Wars had begun, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Ryloth. Reluctant to take power but wanting the best for his people, Syndulla formed the freedom fighters to combat the oppression and launched a [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|campaign]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. However, Syndulla and his forces were forced to retreat from the battlefield, and his fighters set up camp in the remains of several fallen [[Droid/Legends|droid]] vehicles on the plains of [[Cazne/Legends|Cazne]].

Syndulla's leadership qualities led his friend and [[Music/Legends|minstrel]], [[Gobi Glie/Legends|Gobi Glie]], to compose a [[Ballad of Cham Syndulla|song]] about him, though Syndulla was opposed to the ballad's exaggeration of his traits. After [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived with Republic forces to liberate Ryloth, Syndulla resolved his issues with Taa and the Republic and entered into an alliance with them. During the ensuing assault on Ryloth's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] to free the [[City/Legends|city]] from Separatist control, Syndulla led the combined forces of his freedom fighters and the Republic unit [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] to besiege the captured city, and he was eventually able to liberate his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] from the Confederacy.

==Biography==
===Tensions with the Republic===
{{Quote|Cham Syndulla was a radical before the war. He is very unpredictable.''"<br />"''He can't be trusted. I know Syndulla seeks to gain power. We were political rivals.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Orn Free Taa|audio=ChamSyndullaUnpredictable-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
Hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]],<ref name="Complete Season One" /> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Cham Syndulla lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule and was one of his planet's nobility.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Syndulla held [[Politics/Legends|political]] rivalries with the Republic. He mistrusted both the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government<ref name="TCWCE" /> and his planet's Twi'lek [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], believing him to be indifferent to his people's fate while he remained on "comfortable [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]," the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and headquarters of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Because of Syndulla's favoritism and reputation among the Twi'lek people, Taa himself believed that Syndulla sought to gain power on Ryloth and was seeking to disband the democracy that Taa represented in the Senate.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> In addition to his tensions with Taa, Syndulla also opposed his planet's leadership.<ref name="OEG:S1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref>

===The invasion of Ryloth===
====Leader of the resistance====
{{Quote|With our forces stretched so thinly, I'm going to enlist the help of the freedom fighters, led by Cham Syndulla. His fight against the droids has made him a symbol of freedom for the people.|Mace Windu|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> mere [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Clone Wars began,<ref name="Chronicling TCW 1">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars''|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref> [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] and [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] visited [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], Ryloth's capital [[City/Legends|city]]. Argente met with [[Artruk]], a Twi'lek broker that he had hired to conceal treasures from conquered worlds. While the two conferred, Syndulla and fellow Twi'lek [[Voyla]] [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on the pair, believing that they were simply watching another off-worlder coming to steal from their planet. However, Syndulla noted that Argente was bringing treasures to Ryloth, not stealing from it. With the additional presence of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Syndulla suspected that the war was coming to Ryloth. His suspicions proved to be true when the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] sought to steal Argente's treasures<ref name="Covetous">''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]''</ref> and invaded Ryloth with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Although reluctant to take power<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> and untrained as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]],<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961ff54d5c011ff77f8213000b|text=Dataclip: Liberty on Ryloth|na=video file}}</ref> Syndulla wanted his people to be free of the Separatist oppression and formed the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]], a group of his admirers, to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|combat]] the Confederacy.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> By doing so, he hoped to free his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] without the help of the Republic.<ref name="TCWCE" />

[[File:ImaGunDi-TCW.png|left|thumb|224x224px|Syndulla was aided by Ima-Gun-Di (pictured).]]
With Syndulla acting as their [[General/Legends|general]], the freedom fighters were the first to engage the Confederate forces.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Aided by a Republic [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Keeli/Legends|Keeli]], Syndulla and his fighters mounted a defense of a Twi'lek village from a large army of Separatist battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. While a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] encampment was established under a cliff face for the freedom fighters' families&mdash;who had been caught on the battlefield with the soldiers&mdash;Syndulla commanded the insurgents' charge on the approaching [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] from his [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrg]] mount, assisted by his close friend and fellow soldier, [[Gobi Glie/Legends|Gobi Glie]]. Despite their efforts, however, the resistance soon began to run low on food, [[Water/Legends|water]], and ammunition. Di contacted the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was battling the [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|Separatist blockade]] of the planet and had [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dao/Legends|Dao]] relay news of their plight to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], but the fleet was soon annihilated by the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], and the Republic's supply lines were severed. Now cut off from the Republic's re-supply efforts, the Twi'lek&ndash;[[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces lost their right flank to the droids, thereby becoming trapped on the battlefield with the refugee families.<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>

[[File:SyndullaKeeliDi.png|thumb|right|315x315px|Syndulla expresses his misgivings about the Republic to Di, Keeli, and Glie.]]
As Syndulla began to lose hope in the Republic's efforts, Di devised a plan to use their remaining [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]]&mdash;which was too small to carry all of the refugees&mdash;as a bomb to collapse an adjacent pass, allowing the Twi'leks to escape from the battlefield with their families. Di and Keeli, who were willing to sacrifice their lives for the safety of the refugees, would then provide cover with their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] so that the Twi'leks could retreat. Setting the plan into motion, Syndulla and Glie readied their people to leave. As soon as Di and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] had distracted the droids with the trap [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], Syndulla led his people away from the battlefield, and though Di and his troops were slaughtered while providing cover for the Twi'leks, the Republic was able to send a trio of [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class supply ships]]&mdash;having used the nearby planet [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] as a staging ground&mdash;through the Separatist blockade. The Republic [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] sent down [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] with much-needed food and medical supplies for the Twi'leks, much to the relief of Syndulla and his fighters.<ref name="Supply Lines" />

Besides fighting the Separatists at the Twi'lek village, the freedom fighters launched a campaign against the Confederacy on the plains of [[Cazne/Legends|Cazne]]. The plains became littered with scars and craters, but though many Separatists were defeated, the droid forces overwhelmed Syndulla and his fighters and ultimately drove them into hiding. Without the Republic's assistance, the Twi'lek rebellion was left on its own, setting up refugee camps on the Cazne plains while continuing to fight and ambush droid patrols.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Syndulla had become celebrated as a folk hero on Ryloth, and many believed that he should rule his people, though he did not agree.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Twi'leks">{{SWE|groups|twileks|Twi'leks}}</ref> When Glie, who was a [[Music/Legends|minstrel]] in addition to his friend, wrote a [[Ballad of Cham Syndulla|song]] about him, Syndulla was uncomfortable with being considered a legend, viewing himself as a mere soldier. Glie, however, informed him that having legends was important and a key advantage that the Twi'lek people had over the Confederate battle droids.<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" />

====Alliance with the Republic====
{{Quote|I was wondering when you'd find me, Master Jedi.''"<br />"''General Syndulla, I've come for your help.''"<br />"''What makes you think you'll get it?|Cham Syndulla meets Mace Windu|audio=IveComeForYourHelp-LibertyOnRyloth.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
The Republic eventually mounted a major offensive to liberate Ryloth, and after several initial victories against the Separatists,<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref><ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] landed on Ryloth with clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] forces and sought to retake the capital of Lessu from Wat Tambor's command. After Windu and his detachment, [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], suffered losses in an engagement with the Confederacy, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] required the aid of Syndulla and his freedom fighters if Ryloth was to be liberated. Windu arrived at Cazne with the [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] [[Stak/Legends|Stak]] and [[Razor/Legends|Razor]], and after the freedom fighters ambushed a battle droid patrol, Syndulla revealed himself to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Leading Windu and the two clones into the resistance's hideout under a downed Confederate [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], Syndulla conferred with Windu and informed him of the rebellion's defeat at Cazne. Entering the camp's main hall, Syndulla picked up a young Twi'lek girl and met with Glie. Discovering that the minstrel had injured himself, Syndulla told his friend to get better and that he needed him. Even though supplies were short and despite his misgivings about the Republic, Syndulla offered Windu food and beverage, practicing the Twi'lek tradition of hospitality.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

[[File:TwilekFreedomFighters-LibertyOnRyloth.png|thumb|left|315x315px|Syndulla, officially allied with Windu, rallies his freedom fighters for battle.]]
When Windu at first requested that Syndulla ally himself with the Republic, the rebel leader was reluctant to do so because of his mistrust of Taa and the senator's plans to station the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] on Ryloth once the Separatists were defeated. However, after [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]]<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> [[Ponds/Legends|CC-6454]],<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> nicknamed "Ponds," reported to Windu that the Confederacy had begun a bombing campaign and had targeted several Twi'lek villages, Syndulla agreed to enter into negotiations with Taa. In the proceeding [[Hologram/Legends|holoconference]], Syndulla exchanged verbal blows with the senator before Windu restrained the pair from bickering. Shortly thereafter, Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] reported to Windu that his forces had engaged the [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|droid bombers]] that were attacking the Twi'lek villages, and both Taa and Syndulla realized that Tambor was destroying what he himself could not possess. With resolve, Taa promised that the Republic [[Army/Legends|Army]] would not occupy Ryloth after the Confederacy was defeated, and Syndulla vowed that he would not seek political power. Now allied with the Republic, Syndulla rallied his fighters and joined forces with Windu.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

To enter the capital of Lessu, Windu and Syndulla were faced with a problem&mdash;the only access to the city was via a [[Plasma bridge/Legends|retractable bridge]] of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma energy]], and its controls were inside the city itself. Furthermore, Tambor had moved the Twi'lek populace out of the city to sit in front of the capital as "living shields," preventing the Republic from mounting a direct offensive without causing civilian casualties. While observing the city's defenses, Syndulla noticed several Confederate [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] traveling along a nearby cliff and reported to Windu that his spies had informed him that they were carrying treasures for Tambor. Windu took Stak and Razor to infiltrate one of the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to get across the bridge; once they were detected by the bridge's B1 battle droid guards, it was believed that they would only have a few [[Standard second|seconds]] before the pass would be deactivated. Syndulla, Ponds,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> and [[Tae Boon/Legends|Tae Boon]], Syndulla's second-in-command,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> led the combined forces of Lightning Squadron and freedom fighters to give Windu and the clones as much time as possible.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

[[File:Triumphant_fighters_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|right|315x315px|Taa, Syndulla, Windu, and Ponds watch the parade on Ryloth.]]
Windu and the clones were able to get across to the city, and riding a blurrg mount, Syndulla immediately led the charge toward the bridge. The pass was activated just in time, and Syndulla and his men held off the Confederate battle droids in the city while Windu went to find and capture Tambor. After the Techno Union Foreman was cornered, several Separatist ''Hyena''-class [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] attempted to destroy Lessu on orders from the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], but the timely intervention of Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighters]] prevented the capital from being bombed. Tambor surrendered to Syndulla, and the freedom fighters' leader thanked Windu for his assistance in freeing his homeworld. Later, with his rivalries with Taa resolved, Syndulla joined Windu, Ponds, and Taa in watching a parade celebrating Ryloth's liberation.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />

When a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] representative from the Jedi High Council came to Ryloth to follow a [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] lead on the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] sought out Syndulla and asked him for information on Ventress, who had been spotted on Ryloth. Although Syndulla was initially not pleased to see a representative from the Jedi Council, he agreed to pass on his knowledge, revealing that Ventress had been seen on Ryloth before she had left for the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]]. The Jedi Knight then went to Tatooine to speak with Nachkt.<ref name="CWA: Card Commander">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Another armed occupation is not a free Ryloth! How long before I am fighting ''you'', Master Jedi?|Cham Syndulla, to Mace Windu|audio=AnotherArmedOccupation-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Syndulla_charge.png|thumb|right|326x326px|Syndulla leads the Republic forces' charge toward the Lessu bridge.]]
Although initially untrained as a soldier<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Dataclip" /> and not a warrior until the Clone Wars,<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> the revolutionary<ref name="OEG:S1" /> Cham Syndulla was a brilliant tactician<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> and an exemplary leader. Compassionate, inspirational, and determined to free Ryloth from the Confederacy, he was a role model to the people he led, and his fight for the Twi'leks' liberty made him a symbol of freedom for his people.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Although he had a sense of pride about him<ref name="TCWCE" /> and was even a noble,<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> he was humble and disagreed with his friend Gobi Glie's song that illustrated his reputation, believing himself to be a soldier, not a legend.<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" /> He became celebrated as a folk hero for his actions on Ryloth, but though many believed that he should lead the Twi'lek people, he had no intention to assume such a role.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Twi'leks" /> He knew that the galaxy widely saw Ryloth as an outlet for [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]],<ref name="Planets in Peril">''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]''</ref> but he truly loved his homeworld.<ref name="TCWCE" /> Even with low supplies, Syndulla offered Mace Windu food and beverage at the resistance's hideout to express the Twi'lek codes and tradition of hospitality.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Syndulla respected the Jedi as warriors but felt that they were tools of a rotten Republic if the Grand Army was to occupy the liberated Ryloth.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />

[[File:Cham_BG.png|thumb|left|312x312px|Cham Syndulla stood at 1.9 meters.]]
The early stages of the Battle of Ryloth tested Syndulla's faith in the Republic and the Jedi, as he felt betrayed when Republic reinforcements could not be sent to aid his people. He even voiced his eroding belief in the Republic directly to Ima-Gun Di,<ref name="Supply Lines" /> with whom he remained frustrated following the severe delay in Republic relief supplies.<ref name="Explore: Supply Lines">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep303|text="Supply Lines" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> A dedicated fighter, Syndulla did not tolerate dishonesty or corruption in any form.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Syndulla">{{SWE|characters|chamsyndulla|Cham Syndulla}}</ref> He did not trust the Republic<ref name="TCWCE" /> or its Grand Army<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> and sought to devise a way to liberate his beloved Ryloth from the Confederacy on his own;<ref name="TCWCE" /> nor did he trust Orn Free Taa, whom he saw as uncaring of the Twi'lek people's fate. He also believed that any sort of armed occupation, even one installed by the Republic, was not what Ryloth needed. Despite his rivalries with Taa<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> and his opposition to Ryloth's leadership,<ref name="OEG:S1" /> Syndulla was hesitant to become the leader of the freedom fighters.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> However, he sincerely cared for his people;<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> to that end, he believed that he had to act with the best interests of the Twi'leks in mind.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> He swore that the children taking refuge in the rebel camps would inherit a Ryloth that was free of the Separatist occupation, and he was ultimately successful in fulfilling that promise.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />

Even though he hated working with Taa, a politician whom he deemed to be corrupt, Syndulla did not hold onto his pride, his rivalry with the Republic,<ref name="TCWCE" /> or his personal disputes with Taa if doing so meant the loss of his people's lives or freedom. He believed in democracy and promised Taa that he would not seek to gain political power before entering into an alliance with him and Windu to free Ryloth.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Syndulla was able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and understood [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]], his native tongue.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> He had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and skin and was eighty-two [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] in weight<ref name="TCW H2H" /> and stood at 1.9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="TCWCE" /> He had Twi'lek clan [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on his head.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> Despite his non-warrior origins, he was trained in riding blurrg mounts and became an expert at controlling the creatures' powerful bite for use against his adversaries.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> An honorable fighter, he became known for employing an open-handed chop known as the "[[Hammer of Ryloth]]," while also becoming accustomed to using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] as his primary weapons as a result of the war on Ryloth.<ref name="TCW H2H" /> Additionally, he had a certain degree of proficiency in recon and military expertise.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Equipment==
Besides wearing an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] breastplate as a clan heirloom, Cham Syndulla also sported trousers made of [[Jalavash worm]] silk.<ref name="TCWCE" /> For weaponry, he used the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44]] and [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 models]] of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], often employing a customized version of the former.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It really poses an interesting question about how Cham sees the occupation by the Separatists and by the Republic. To him, it's just another army. Who is on the right side here? And characters like Cham Syndulla question that.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]], on Syndulla's questioning of the Republic's intent to occupy Ryloth following its liberation|<ref name="Complete Season One" />}}
Cham Syndulla was created for the [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series<ref name="OEG:S1" /> and first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Covetous|''Covetous'']],<ref name="Covetous" /> though he was not identified by name until the later-released [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: The Ballad of Cham Syndulla|''The Ballad of Cham Syndulla'']].<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" /> He was voiced by [[Robin Atkin Downes]] in the television series and was featured in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Liberty on Ryloth]],"<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide" /> as well as ''The Ballad of Cham Syndulla'', which led into the episode.<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" />

With the television series' prominent [[Wikipedia:French people|French]] influence on Twi'leks,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Commentary">{{SW|url=video/liberty-on-ryloth-episode-featurette|text="Liberty on Ryloth" Episode Featurette}}</ref> Downes voiced Syndulla with a [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] accent.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Consequently, the Twi'leks' symbolism and parallels to the French also caused Syndulla to emerge as the leader of the "[[Wikipedia:French Resistance|French Resistance]]" on Ryloth opposing the Separatists. Syndulla was originally a conniving religious figure affiliated with the Separatists in "Liberty on Ryloth," but because of later changes to the episode's plot, he was changed to a freedom fighter leading the Twi'lek resistance.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Commentary" />

===Non-canon history===
In [[2011]], Syndulla was given a role in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of the non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. In addition to presenting a more humorous and comical adaptation of "Liberty on Ryloth," the game modified the episode's storyline, with Syndulla being captured by Separatist forces and necessitating Mace Windu's help to free him. Syndulla is made available as an in-game playable character following the "Liberty on Ryloth" level.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III DS">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition}}</ref> In a similar fashion, in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] version of the game, Syndulla is captured by the Separatists and is imprisoned in a cage inside a cave on Ryloth. Once he is freed from his battle droid captors by Windu and two clone troopers, Syndulla gratefully leads them out of the cave system and points them in the direction of a guarded Multi-Troop Transport, which Windu and his comrades later commandeer to cross the plasma bridge to Lessu. After the level, Syndulla is also made available for in-game purchase, to be used in the game's "Free Play" mode.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III PSP">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] edition}}</ref>

''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head]]'' introduces a non-canon matchup between Syndulla and [[Brother/Legends|Brother]] [[Viscus/Legends|Viscus]], the leader of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Given his honorable conduct, Syndulla avoids using his blasters upon seeing that Viscus is not using any ranged weapons. Howver, Viscus does not hesitate to employ a deadly chained blade, exploiting Syndulla's ethical code to defeat him.<ref name="TCW H2H" />
